# ByteShelf

> A self-hosted file store. Files live on shelves: each shelf is its own tree of directories and
> files, with its own trash, quota, users' access and keys. This server answers an agent three ways:
> MCP at /mcp, the byteshelf command line, and its REST API under /api.

Paths on a shelf start with `/`, the shelf's root. A program reaches one shelf with a shelf key (a
secret starting `bsk_`) that an admin makes in the web UI's shelf settings, with one of three
permissions: read, add-only (read, and store new files, never replace or remove) or read-write.

## MCP

- `/mcp` on this server: MCP over Streamable HTTP. Send the key as `Authorization: Bearer <key>` (or
  in `X-Api-Key`). It reaches the key's own shelf, and offers only the tools the key's permission
  allows (only reading ones on a replica). The server tells the agent the shelf's name when it
  connects, and every tool works on that shelf when shelf is left out. It cannot read or write the
  agent's own files: upload text or base64 (up to 256 KiB), read text of up to 256 KiB or a PNG,
  JPEG, GIF or WebP image of up to 1 MiB, and use share_file for a link to anything else. Add it to
  Claude Code with this server's address and the key:
  `claude mcp add --transport http byteshelf https://<this-server>/mcp --header "Authorization: Bearer bsk_..."`
- `byteshelf --mcp`: the same tools over stdio on the agent's own machine, signed in as the CLI is,
  plus moving local files and whole folders. Add it with `claude mcp add byteshelf -- byteshelf --mcp`.

## Command line

- Install with `dotnet tool install -g ByteShelf.Cli`. With `BYTESHELF_URL` and `BYTESHELF_KEY` set it
  needs no login.
- `byteshelf whoami`, `shelves`, `ls`, `tree`, `find`, `stat`, `get`, `put`, `mkdir`, `describe`,
  `share`, `mv`, `rm`, `trash`, `restore`, `empty-trash`; `--json` prints the server's JSON. A place
  is written `shelf:/path`. `byteshelf help` lists every command.
- [The CLI's guide](https://github.com/AdamTovatt/byte-shelf/blob/master/ByteShelf.Cli/README.md)
- [A skill for agents using it](https://github.com/AdamTovatt/byte-shelf/blob/master/skills/byteshelf/SKILL.md):
  for Claude Code, copy its folder to `~/.claude/skills/byteshelf/`.

## REST API

- Shelf endpoints are under `/api/shelves/{shelf}` and take the key in `X-Api-Key` or as a bearer
  token. Errors answer `{ "code": ..., "message": ... }` with a code such as `not_found`.
- [Storage endpoints](https://github.com/AdamTovatt/byte-shelf/blob/master/ByteShelf.Server/Storage/Storage.md)
- [Who may do what](https://github.com/AdamTovatt/byte-shelf/blob/master/ByteShelf.Server/Access/Access.md)
- [ByteShelfClient, the .NET client](https://github.com/AdamTovatt/byte-shelf/blob/master/ByteShelfClient/README.md)
